name: Entry Intent Status
summary: Tracks the ephemeral application-entry intent independently from canonical identity state and client navigation.

values.name: None
values.summary: No entry intent is attached to the current interaction.

values.name: Stashed
values.summary: A validated entry intent is retained for later routing.

values.name: Consumed
values.summary: The entry intent was explicitly consumed once by a dedicated action.

values.name: Expired
values.summary: The entry intent expired before use.

values.name: Invalid
values.summary: The entry intent failed validation and cannot influence routing.

sourceReferences.note: Entry intent stash, TTL, and destructive ConsumeAsync contract.
